gaps.name: invention-exploration-spread
gaps.notes: Side-by-side layout: diagram or photo of the invention on one side, guided questions on the other (How does it work? What problem did it solve? What came before it?)

notes: Same Mike Venezia 'Getting to Know' series as the artists and composers books Aless dropped today. 33-page CamScanner scan, mostly landscape spreads with portrait cover and back pages. The book introduces children to famous inventors and scientists through narrative biographies with Venezia's signature mix of humor, cartoon illustrations, and real photographs or diagrams. No hands-on activities -- pure reading + visual appreciation. Complements the artists and composers books as a trio covering art, music, and science history. The gap here parallels the artists book: Homa has no biography-style reading or scientist study formats. Together these three drops signal strong interest in a 'famous people' study unit format spanning multiple subjects.
